text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. At the heart of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. A more advanced form, deep learning, uses complex neural networks to process huge amounts of information, allowing AI to improve on its own. You encounter AI every day: it recommends videos, filters spam emails, powers voice assistants, and helps doctors diagnose diseases. While AI is not perfect, it continues to change how we work and live.
